entities.name: T3412 extended value
entities.description: An optional information element that the network may include to provide the UE with a longer periodic tracking area update timer value.

entities.name: Periodic tracking area update
entities.description: A procedure where the UE periodically updates its tracking area with the network.

entities.name: T3412 timer
entities.description: Timer used for periodic tracking area update procedure.

relations.description: The T3412 extended value IE provides a longer timer value for the T3412 timer.
The periodic tracking area update procedure uses the T3412 timer.
